candidate.source_a: Calcium phosphate forms crystalline deposits in bone tissue through osteoblast-mediated mineralization.
candidate.source_b: Marine diatoms precipitate silica-based cell walls using enzymatic silicatein proteins.

counterfactuals: If Source A mentioned protein catalysis, it would support the candidate.
If Source B mentioned oxide precipitation (not just silica), it would support the candidate.

evidence_assessment.notes: Neither source directly supports the candidate phrase. Source A discusses calcium phosphate precipitation but doesn't mention protein catalysis. Source B discusses protein-catalyzed precipitation but only of silica, not oxides. The GLiREL relations don't establish the connection between proteins and oxide precipitation in either source.
